meta.desc: Download TikTok videos without watermark and save TikTok photos in HD - free, no login, no install. Works on iPhone, Android, PC and Mac.
faq1.a: Absolutely. Downloading TikTok videos without a watermark costs nothing - no account, no subscription, no hidden fees.
faq2.q: Do I need to install the DownTik app?
faq2.a: Not at all. DownTik works right in your browser on any phone, tablet, or computer - there is no app to download.
faq3.q: Can I download TikTok photos without watermark?
faq3.a: Yes. Slideshow posts can be saved image by image, and multi-photo posts let you grab several at once.
faq4.a: Anything with a browser: iPhone, Android, iPad, Mac, Windows, Linux.
faq5.a: The same quality TikTok publishes - nothing is re-encoded.
faq6.a: Yes - Douyin links work the same way. Paste a valid Douyin video link and grab the file it offers.
faq7.a: No. DownTik never hosts or stores the videos you download - it just fetches the public source to your device.
faq8.q: Where are downloaded TikTok videos saved?
faq8.a: It depends on your device. On iPhone and iPad the file can be saved to the Files app or your photo library, on Android it lands in the Downloads folder and usually appears in the gallery, and on PC or Mac it goes to your browser's default download folder, which you can change in the browser settings.
faq9.q: Is there a limit on how many videos I can download?
faq9.a: No caps at all. Download as many videos, photos, or audio tracks as you want - no account, no queue, no daily limit.
faq10.q: Can I download videos from private TikTok accounts?
faq10.a: No. Only public videos can be fetched, the same as what you would see on TikTok itself. Private content is never reachable.
faq11.q: Does DownTik work on iPhone and Android?
faq11.a: Yes. DownTik runs in any browser on iPhone, iPad and Android - no app to install. On iPhone downloads land in the Files app, on Android in the Downloads folder and usually the gallery.
faq12.q: Can I download TikTok videos in 4K?
faq12.a: Where the creator uploaded 4K, yes - DownTik serves the best stream TikTok has for the post, up to 4K, without re-encoding.
faq13.a: For watermark-free downloads, yes: DownTik is free with no caps and no watermarked preview, while SnapTik's free tier now stamps its own logo on downloads.
faq14.a: No. There is no tracking, no accounts and no download history - links are processed in memory and discarded.
